Thank you for doing this. I know how it looks, me going through his phone.
His phone lights up on the nightstand after midnight. He flips it face down and rolls over like nothing happened.
Boyd's never had a reason to text anyone that late. Cows don't text. 😔
Who's the woman texting him after midnight?

I don't know a single Joelle. Not from church, not from the co-op, nowhere.
Around here everybody knows everybody's whole family tree, back three generations.
What's Joelle's last name?

I had to sit down for a minute.
I keep telling myself it's something about his dad's estate. Some old paperwork.
But lawyers aren't cheap, and Boyd watches every dollar like it's the last one.
How much has Boyd paid her?

That's real money for us. Milk prices have been awful all year.
A few weeks back he was gone the whole day. Texted me he was at the implement dealer in Marshfield getting parts.
He came home with no parts.
The day he said he was at the implement dealer, which city was he really in?
questions.hint: Check his Calendar, then his Photos.

questions.text:
Over an hour each way, and he told me it was tractor parts.
One night I heard him on the phone out by the milk house. All he said was, "Okay. I'll start keeping it."
I've been turning that over in my head for weeks.
What did that lawyer tell him to start keeping?

Boyd has never written anything down in his life except milk weights.
And then there's the one o'clock thing. Boots on, out the door, says he's checking the heifers.
The heifer barn is right out back. I can see it from the bedroom window, and the light never comes on.
Where exactly does he go at one in the morning?

So he's been watching that barn. For what?
Nobody's stored anything out there in years. It's an empty building on a gravel road.
Over the past 14 nights, how many times did a vehicle pull up to that barn?
questions.hint: Look through the albums in his Photos.

onboarding.text: Boyd's phone is on the kitchen charger and he's at the sale barn until two. Fourteen years married, and I've never once looked at it. I don't even know how to begin.
onboarding.label: Nadine

onboarding.text: We got married in the hayloft of his dad's barn. Boyd cried before I did. He still brings me coffee out to the car on cold mornings, black, two sugars, without asking.
onboarding.label: Nadine & Boyd

onboarding.text: Boyd's a third-generation dairy farmer. A hundred and ten head, up at four every day of his life. He doesn't lie well and doesn't talk much. Lately he goes out around one in the morning.
onboarding.label: Boyd

onboarding.text: And someone texts him after midnight. A woman, I'd bet on it. I work at the county farm office. I deal in paperwork and facts. So get me the facts, please, before he's home.
onboarding.label: Nadine

Last check came in the mail yet? Just checking, mine hasn't shown up

Came today. Thanks
Great. Brand inspector will be out for the next sale so have the hides clean
Always do
Ha, true. Ear tag question: do your culls have the electronic tags or just the metal?

We're doing a hay auction in a couple weeks, thought you might want a heads up
Not buying this year. Got enough put up
Good for you. Weigh-in for your consignment is set for the morning of the sale
I'll be there around 7
See you then 👍
Morning. You still got that post pounder?
Yep, in the machine shed. Come grab it
Will after chores

Dry spring. Rain tonight supposedly
Believe it when I see it
Saw your heifers out by the road fence again
Dang. Which spot
By the culvert. I pushed them back in, wire's down
Thanks Gordy. I'll fix it first thing
Marge says come for supper sometime
Will do. Tell her thanks
Radar looks bad for this afternoon. You got hay down?
Mowed 40 acres yesterday. Praying
Hail took out half of Owen's last time. Hope it goes around
If it hits I'm blaming you 😂
Fair
Need to borrow your tedder for a day or two
Sure. Hitch is the same as yours I think
Pin hitch, yeah
Take it. Grease it first, I ran it last week and didn't
Will do
Fireworks keep Tuck going all night?
Under the bed shaking. Cows didn't care
Our old dog same. Marge gave him half a pill
Might ask Dr. Moua about that for Tuck
Tedder is back at your place?
Brought it home yesterday. Left it by your shed. Greased it too
Saw it. Thanks
Hay's all in. 310 round bales
Good yield for this year
Better than last. Prices are another story
Your milk truck was early today. Passed him at the corner
Co-op changed the route. Pickup is 5:30 now
Rain gauge says 1.3 inches this morning
Mine says 1.1. Finally
Corn will like it
County crew is grading our road tomorrow
Good. Washboard's been rattling my teeth loose
You see the Packers moved the preseason opener? Heidi wants to go if you're in.
Can't. Milking's at 3:45, I'm no good after.
You say that every year. 😂
Hey, got a set of the 11R22.5s in for your feed truck. Come by when you can.
Will do. Thursday's bad, I've got the hoof trimmer.
RKT-4471 — know whose this is?
Gray full-size pickup? That's Phil Sandoval's truck. Put tires on it this year. The FSA guy in Neillsville.
Thanks. Just curious. Keep it between us.
Always. You doing alright?
Fine. Long summer.
Walleye are biting at Lake Arbutus. Saturday morning, you and me, 5 AM?
I'll see if I can get Curt's kid to cover chores. Not promising.
I'll bring the minnows either way.
Boyd, you coming to pinochle this month or are the cows keeping you?
Cows. Hay is down in two fields
Fair enough. We'll save your seat
Did you see the Brewers last night? Bullpen blew it again
Fell asleep in the chair in the sixth
Smart. Didn't miss much
Can I borrow your post pounder? Fixing fence along the creek
It's in the machine shed behind the skid steer. Take it
Got it, thanks. Will have it back in a few days
Your well pump still making that noise? Mine did the same and it was the pressure switch
Rattles when it kicks on. Maybe I'll check the switch
Thirty bucks at the hardware. Easy fix
Replaced it. Quiet now. Owe you a beer
I'll hold you to it 🍺
Returned the pounder. Left it where you said
Saw it. Thanks
Thinking of going up to the lake for a couple days after the fair. Want to come?
Can't leave the herd. Maybe in the fall
Fall then. Deer opener is not that far off either
Don't remind me. Stand needs work
I've got a ladder stand that's too big for me. You can have it if you want
I'll take it. Stop by when you're passing
Cull cows brought $1.12 a pound at the sale barn last week. Anybody seeing different?
Same around here. Beef market is carrying everything
Heifer calves aren't moving though
What are you asking for the 400 lb ones, Leroy?
Four hundred a head and still no calls
Try the Thursday sale. More buyers show up
Cull cow prices at Neillsville this week: $98 to $112 per cwt, boners at the top.
Bred heifers are still stout. Had a set go at $2,900.
Hay prices up 15 percent over spring. Feeders will feel it
My feed bill says so already
Anyone need a hauler with a gooseneck? Mine's open Saturdays
I might. Send me a rate
Will text you direct
Anyone need a load of springers? Got 14 coming fresh in September.
Call me, I might have a taker.
Sale barn is expecting a big run this month. Culls are coming in early with the dry spell
Then prices will soften. Go early if you're going
Noted. Thanks
Wade, you still have that scale ticket template?
Will send it tonight
Reminder: sale barn is closed for the fair day. Next sale as normal.
Church potluck is coming up. Bev, are you still doing the bars?
Lemon bars, yes. Bringing two pans
I'll bring the buns from the bakery
Bakery buns, Boyd? In my day we baked
Ma I milk cows 365 days a year
Fair enough
Ma, the furnace guy said to change the filter every three months. I put a reminder on your fridge.
Thank you boys. Bev is bringing the rhubarb bars Sunday.
Extra butter this time, Bev. 😄
Don't you start. Your mother's recipe uses what it uses.
Ma's hip doing okay? Doctor appointment went all right?
Better. PT is helping. Don't fuss
I'll drive you to the next one, Ma
You've got cows. Bev can take me
Happy to. I'll bring a puzzle
Church potluck is on the 9th. I'm signing us up for the baked beans.
Count me in for beans.
Clover's bulling. Tail paint is rubbed off and she's been standing since last evening
I'm out your way tomorrow around 7:30. Hold her in the sorting pen
Should I wait for tomorrow? She's hot now
Seen standing in the evening, breed in the morning. You're right on time
Ok. Pen will be ready
Bred Clover and #198. Used the sexed straw on Clover. Slip is in the milk house door
Got it. Thanks Jerry
New sire catalog came in. Few high-component bulls I think you'd like
What are they running on feet and legs?
Good on the one I'm thinking of. I'll bring the book next visit
Tank is getting low on the yard side. Can you swing by Thursday to fill it?
I'll be there the day after tomorrow. Nitrogen truck comes in tomorrow
Sounds good
Filled it. You were at 4 inches. Don't let it drop below that again
Noted. I'll check it weekly
Marigold is bulling again. Third try. Vet says maybe cull. Want to try once more?
I'd give her one more with a beef sire. If she doesn't take, you know what to do
Fair enough. Come out in the morning
Bred her. Fingers crossed
Your breeding invoice is in the mail. Straws plus the farm calls
I'll write you a check this week
No rush
Heat check: #340 is acting off. Mounting the others
She was open at the preg check?
Yep
Then it's real. I'll be out this afternoon
Bred #340 with the new sire. Her record says first lactation heifer so go easy on her
Will do
Co-op meeting next week. You going?
Probably not. Bed by 9 and it runs late
Ha. Same here. I'll tell you if anything's worth knowing
Heifer group is due for breeding in a few weeks. Should I order straws now?
Yes, order ahead. I'll put in for 15 straws
Make it 20
20 it is
Boyd it's Marge. Gordy says you have his socket set again 😄
Ha. I'll bring it by. Tell him I'm sorry

Don't need to do that
Too late, it's in the oven
Church is doing the potluck after service this month. Can you bring bars or a dish?
I'll ask at home what we have. Probably bars
Wonderful. I'll put you down for dessert
Is Tuck still limping? Gordy said he saw him favoring a leg
Better. Doc says he pulled something chasing a heifer. Rest for a week
Poor guy. Tell him I have a bone
He'll be at your door
Gordy's got the combine in the shop. Said he might need a hand with the cutter bar if you have time
After afternoon milking I can come over
I'll tell him. Supper's at six if you want to eat with us
Thanks, may take you up on it
Thank you for helping Gordy. He came in all happy and greasy
Anytime
Our granddaughter is showing a calf at the fair. Do you remember the clipping tips you gave Gordy?
Wash her twice, blow dry against the hair, clip last day. I'll write it down
Perfect, she'll love it
Zucchini is out of control again. Want some? I'll leave a bag on your porch
Sure, thank you
Left two bags. Sorry 😅
Dr. Moua, Dottie's off feed and her temp is 104. Can you come by today?
I can be there around 10. Keep her in the sick pen
Will do

Strip it out every few hours. Do I dump the milk?
Yes, discard for four days after the last tube. Red leg tape so nobody mixes her in
Got the tape on her
Want to do preg checks on the March breeding group. What's your schedule like?
I can do June 5 at 8 AM
Works. I'll have the headgates cleaned out
How many?
20 confirmed, 4 open, 2 I want to recheck in a month
Which are open?
Marigold, 212, 340 and 118
Marigold again. She's been a problem cow for a year
Third time open. I'd start thinking about culling her
Yeah. Let me think on it
Heifer calf born last night, 80 lbs, up and nursing by 5
Nice. Did she get colostrum in the first two hours?
4 quarts by bottle
Perfect. Dip the navel in iodine if you haven't
Done. Named her Daisy
Your vaccine order came in. J5 and the scour boluses
I'll stop by after afternoon milking tomorrow
Clinic closes at 5. Front desk can hand it to you
Clover's limping on the right hind. Not bad but she's favoring it
Probably a sole ulcer or something stuck. Hoof trimmer is in your area next week, have him look
Will do. I'll call him
If she gets worse, text me a video of her walking
Trimmer found an abscess. Packed it and put a block on. She's walking fine now
Great, glad it was caught early
Tuck's rabies booster is due. The clinic will text you
Good, he's overdue. Anything for the thunder shaking?
There's a calming chew. Bring him in and we'll go over it
Thanks Ellen
Fall seed orders open next month. Want me to hold your usual alfalfa mix?
Yes. Same as last time, maybe 10 acres more
Will pencil it in
Boyd, Todd with Weiss Seed. Winter rye pricing is out if you want to lock it in for fall.
Send me the sheet. I'll look it over.
Sent to your email. Early order discount runs through the end of the month.
Early order discount ends the 1st. I'll email a price sheet
Send it to the farm email, I check that one
Done. And the corn on your south field looks great from the road
Rain helped
Always does

Same as last time. Add two tons of the pellet if you can

I'm in the barn till 6:30 then back to the house. Tell him to just go ahead, lid's unlocked
Will do 👍
Boyd, the driver says the bin was about empty. Might want to bump your order next time
Yeah the heat has them eating more. Put me down for the bigger load next time
Got it. Invoice for last month went to your email, it's the one with the fuel surcharge
Saw it. Why is the surcharge so high
Diesel went up again. I'll ask the office if they can adjust it since you're a regular
Appreciate it
They took $40 off. Will show on next statement
Good enough. Thanks Sherry
Reminder the mill is closed for the holiday. Orders placed after noon go out the next business day
We have mineral tubs on special this month if you want some for the heifers
How many can you spare
Six no problem. I'll put them on the next truck
Sounds good

Call me, I'm on the tractor
Tried you, no answer. I'll try after you finish milking
Got your voicemail. Called back, we're good on the numbers. Thanks

Happy to do the calf corner again
I can do an afternoon shift. Denny's covering the tire shop
Boyd, can you bring two or three calves for the petting area?
I can bring three. Daisy's too young, but I've got a couple of 6-week-old heifers
Perfect. Do they need to be halter broke?
They'll follow a bucket. That's about it
😂 that works
Fair office needs a final head count for the milking demo by the end of the month
I'll have two Holsteins. Clover and Dottie. Both are gentle
Dottie's the one who had the mastitis?
Cleared up fine. Milk's been clean for weeks
Good to know. Wash stations will be set up by the east door
Who's bringing the bedding?
I'll bring shavings. Two bales
Thank you Boyd
Pie sale is the second day. Please send your best pie. Marlys has a spreadsheet
Tammy that's a sign-up sheet, not a spreadsheet
Same thing. Rhubarb or apple?
I'm buying one. I'm not a baker
Store bought counts, just keep the receipt 😂
Reminder: setup is the day before opening, 3 PM. Bring a pitchfork
I'll be a little late, afternoon milking first. 5:30 ok?
Fine
Calves arrived fine. They're being little celebrities
Heidi, a kid tried to feed one a corn dog
Oh no. Did the calf eat it
Mom caught it first
Good. Tell them no people food
Milking demo drew about 60 people. Great job Boyd
Clover did the work
Teardown is tomorrow morning. Any help appreciated
I'll be there after chores to haul the calves home
Thanks everyone. We raised $1,840 for the 4-H scholarship fund
That's better than last year!
Pies helped
Store bought ones too 😂
We see you Boyd
